title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1988-09-23
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi Dragon) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Izotope RX8 Advanced > Adobe Audition CC2022 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy

ai_review.summary: Pristine ultramatrix capture of a standout 1988 MSG show featuring killer Dupree’s Diamond Blues and Ship of Fools.
ai_review.review: The reviewer hails this recording as the favorite from the 1988 run, praising an all‑nutsack first set with highlights like Dupree’s Diamond Blues and Ship of Fools. The Charlie Miller‑mastered UltraMatrix is described as pristine and beautifully done, delivering crystal‑clear sound that lets the performance shine.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the musical performance (standout setlist) and the recording quality (pristine ultramatrix), indicating an exceptional show with excellent sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mastering described as beautiful, pristine, and flawless; Charlie Miller's UltraMatrix work praised for delivering high‑fidelity sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set called "all nutsack" with a fantastic setlist; reviewer anticipates an equally strong second set.
